About PTCI

Shaping Palawano professionals since 1995.

Palawan Technological College, Inc. (PTCI) has been a cornerstone of quality education in Puerto Princesa City for over three decades. Our institution provides an environment that fosters intellectual growth, technical proficiency, and moral integrity — preparing graduates who are ready for the modern workforce.

With affordable tuition, flexible scheduling, and no minimum grade requirements for admission, PTCI makes quality education genuinely accessible to every Palawano.

Mission

To provide holistic, accessible, and globally competitive education that transforms students into highly skilled professionals.

Vision

To be the leading technological institution in Palawan, recognized for innovation, research, and community service.
